verses.en: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
verses.pt: Ouvi, filhos, a instrução do pai, e estai atentos para conhecerdes o entendimento.
verses.en_web: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, my sons, to the teaching of a father; give attention so that you may have knowledge:

verses.en: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
verses.pt: Pois eu vos dou boa doutrina; não abandoneis o meu ensino.
verses.en_web: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
verses.en_bbe: For I give you good teaching; do not give up the knowledge you are getting from me.

verses.en: For I was my father’s son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
verses.pt: Quando eu era filho aos pés de meu, pai, tenro e único em estima diante de minha mãe,
verses.en_web: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
verses.en_bbe: For I was a son to my father, a gentle and an only one to my mother.

verses.en: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
verses.pt: ele me ensinava, e me dizia: Retenha o teu coração as minhas palavras; guarda os meus mandamentos, e vive.
verses.en_web: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave me teaching, saying to me, Keep my words in your heart; keep my rules so that you may have life:

verses.en: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
verses.pt: Adquire a sabedoria, adquire o entendimento; não te esqueças nem te desvies das palavras da minha boca.
verses.en_web: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Get wisdom, get true knowledge; keep it in memory, do not be turned away from the words of my mouth.

verses.en: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
verses.pt: Não a abandones, e ela te guardará; ama-a, e ela te preservará.
verses.en_web: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
verses.en_bbe: Do not give her up, and she will keep you; give her your love, and she will make you safe.

verses.en: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
verses.pt: A sabedoria é a coisa principal; adquire, pois, a sabedoria; sim, com tudo o que possuis adquire o entendimento.
verses.en_web: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
verses.en_bbe: The first sign of wisdom is to get wisdom; go, give all you have to get true knowledge.

verses.en: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
verses.pt: Estima-a, e ela te exaltará; se a abraçares, ela te honrará.
verses.en_web: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor, when you embrace her.
verses.en_bbe: Put her in a high place, and you will be lifted up by her; she will give you honour, when you give her your love.

verses.en: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
verses.pt: Ela dará à tua cabeça uma grinalda de graça; e uma coroa de glória te entregará.
verses.en_web: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
verses.en_bbe: She will put a crown of grace on your head, giving you a head-dress of glory.

verses.en: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
verses.pt: Ouve, filho meu, e aceita as minhas palavras, para que se multipliquem os anos da tua vida.
verses.en_web: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, O my son, and let your heart be open to my sayings; and long life will be yours.

verses.en: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
verses.pt: Eu te ensinei o caminho da sabedoria; guiei-te pelas veredas da retidão.
verses.en_web: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
verses.en_bbe: I have given you teaching in the way of wisdom, guiding your steps in the straight way.

verses.en: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
verses.pt: Quando andares, não se embaraçarão os teus passos; e se correres, não tropeçarás.
verses.en_web: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
verses.en_bbe: When you go, your way will not be narrow, and in running you will not have a fall.

verses.en: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
verses.pt: Apega-te à instrução e não a largues; guarda-a, porque ela é a tua vida.
verses.en_web: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
verses.en_bbe: Take learning in your hands, do not let her go: keep her, for she is your life.

verses.en: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
verses.pt: Não entres na vereda dos ímpios, nem andes pelo caminho dos maus.
verses.en_web: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
verses.en_bbe: Do not go in the road of sinners, or be walking in the way of evil men.

verses.en: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
verses.pt: Evita-o, não passes por ele; desvia-te dele e passa de largo.
verses.en_web: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
verses.en_bbe: Keep far from it, do not go near; be turned from it, and go on your way.

verses.en: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
verses.pt: Pois não dormem, se não fizerem o mal, e foge deles o sono se não fizerem tropeçar alguém.
verses.en_web: For they don’t sleep, unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
verses.en_bbe: For they take no rest till they have done evil; their sleep is taken away if they have not been the cause of someone's fall.

verses.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
verses.pt: Porque comem o pão da impiedade, e bebem o vinho da violência.
verses.en_web: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
verses.en_bbe: The bread of evil-doing is their food, the wine of violent acts their drink.

verses.en: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
verses.pt: Mas a vereda dos justos é como a luz da aurora que vai brilhando mais e mais até ser dia perfeito.
verses.en_web: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light, that shines more and more until the perfect day.
verses.en_bbe: But the way of the upright is like the light of early morning, getting brighter and brighter till the full day.

verses.en: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
verses.pt: O caminho dos ímpios é como a escuridão: não sabem eles em que tropeçam.
verses.en_web: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
verses.en_bbe: The way of sinners is dark; they see not the cause of their fall.

verses.en: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
verses.pt: Filho meu, atenta para as minhas palavras; inclina o teu ouvido às minhas instroções.
verses.en_web: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
verses.en_bbe: My son, give attention to my words; let your ear be turned to my sayings.

verses.en: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
verses.pt: Não se apartem elas de diante dos teus olhos; guarda-as dentro do teu coração.
verses.en_web: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
verses.en_bbe: Let them not go from your eyes; keep them deep in your heart.

verses.en: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
verses.pt: Porque são vida para os que as encontram, e saúde para todo o seu corpo.
verses.en_web: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
verses.en_bbe: For they are life to him who gets them, and strength to all his flesh.

verses.en: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
verses.pt: Guarda com toda a diligência o teu coração, porque dele procedem as fontes da vida.
verses.en_web: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
verses.en_bbe: And keep watch over your heart with all care; so you will have life.

verses.en: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
verses.pt: Desvia de ti a malignidade da boca, e alonga de ti a perversidade dos lábios.
verses.en_web: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
verses.en_bbe: Put away from you an evil tongue, and let false lips be far from you.

verses.en: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.pt: Dirijam-se os teus olhos para a frente, e olhem as tuas pálpebras diretamente diante de ti.
verses.en_web: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
verses.en_bbe: Keep your eyes on what is in front of you, looking straight before you.

verses.en: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
verses.pt: Pondera a vereda de teus pés, e serão seguros todos os teus caminhos.
verses.en_web: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
verses.en_bbe: Keep a watch on your behaviour; let all your ways be rightly ordered.

verses.en: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
verses.pt: Não declines nem para a direita nem para a esquerda; retira o teu pé do mal.
verses.en_web: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
verses.en_bbe: Let there be no turning to the right or to the left, keep your feet from evil.
